profile.bio: Owns refunds, replacements, support and the post-purchase journey for Preserve, and is the team member closest to what happens after a buyer prepays. Pushes to replace 'message me' with a written refund-or-replacement promise, a dead-seed remedy flow and order updates through the 3-4 week wait (all proposals, since the refund policy is UNKNOWN in the seed). Allies with the Plant & Horticulture Specialist on a combined guide-plus-remedy fix and keeps gift buyers' exposure to delays and refunds in view.
profile.personality: Empathetic, persistent, customer-obsessed, outspoken, impatient with vague answers
profile.stance: Remedy-first champion -- sees silence on remedy as the biggest repeat killer; wants a public refund-or-replacement promise and dead-seed flow labelled as proposals, and expects to clash with Finance on cost, Legal on wording and the Founder on public vs DM-only answers
interests: order and shipping updates during the wait
